exposure: Mityvac M-style conventional vacuum-assisted delivery system
cohort: 507 women who underwent attempted vacuum-assisted delivery
finding: The Kiwi handheld vacuum-assisted delivery system was associated with a higher overall failure rate compared to the Mityvac M-style conventional system, particularly in specific fetal positions and stations.
